title: Production Images
summary: Turn a working image into a production one: multi-stage TypeScript builds, the right base image (slim, alpine, distroless, Chainguard/Wolfi, Docker Hardened Images), non-root users, BuildKit cache/secret/SSH mounts, multi-platform builds with buildx, health checks, OCI labels, SBOM and provenance attestations, tagging strategy and linting.
objectives: Write a multi-stage Dockerfile that compiles TypeScript and ships only production dependencies and build output
Compare base image families and choose one based on size, CVEs, debuggability and libc compatibility
Run containers as a non-root user and understand the Kubernetes runAsNonRoot implications
Use BuildKit cache mounts, secret mounts and SSH mounts without leaking credentials into layers
Build and push multi-platform (linux/amd64 + linux/arm64) images with buildx and inspect manifest lists
Add HEALTHCHECK, OCI labels, SBOM and provenance attestations, and apply a semver + git SHA tagging strategy
Lint Dockerfiles with hadolint and scan images with Trivy
